segments.he: תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: ״הֲרֵינִי נָזִיר כֹּל יְמֵי חַיַּי״, ״הֲרֵינִי נְזִיר עוֹלָם״ — הֲרֵי זֶה נְזִיר עוֹלָם. אֲפִילּוּ ״מֵאָה שָׁנָה״, אֲפִילּוּ ״אֶלֶף שָׁנִים״ — אֵין זֶה נְזִיר עוֹלָם, אֶלָּא נָזִיר לְעוֹלָם.
segments.en: § «The Sages taught:» If «one says: I am hereby a nazirite all the days of my life,» or: «I am hereby a permanent nazirite, he is a permanent nazirite» and he trims his hair on a yearly basis like Absalom. However, in the case of one who accepts upon himself naziriteship for a fixed amount of time, «even» if he says: «One hundred years» or «even: One thousand years, he is not» the specific type of nazirite known as «a permanent nazirite. Rather,» he is a regular «nazirite forever,» and he may never cut his hair.

moves.summary: baraita distinguishing permanent nazirite from nazirite forever
